Five pieces come to about 125 cm³ before allowing for gaps, and the actual figure is probably closer to 90–100 cm³. At about 1.0 g/cm³ that is roughly 95 g.

The potatoes look roasted or fried, so I'm using about 110 kcal per 100 g. I don't see any visible oil or sauce apart from a slight residue on the plate.
